content:
Overview

Krasnoyarsk is a city in Krasnoyarsk Krai with a population of 1,090,000. A major Siberian city on the Yenisei River, a center of hydroelectric power and aluminum production, surrounded by stunning nature. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4a growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
